description.en: Original Planolites smooth-burrow trace concept informed by P.beverleyensis KUMIP288539 and the original inventory winding-tube requirement. Source supports smooth unlined subcylindrical fill and near-constant diameter; the longer gently sinuous course and16cm teaching slab are artistic genus-level composition rather than exact specimen. No producer, behavior, site replica or date beyond the source-scoped Carboniferous tag asserted.
